content.title: When Does the Rest of ‘The Boys’ Come Out? Season 5 Release Schedule, Episode Count and More for the Final Season
content.text: Key PointsThe Boys Season 5, premiering April 8, 2026, is the show’s final chapter.Season 5 features eight episodes, with new episodes releasing Wednesdays on Prime Video.Supernatural stars Misha Collins and Jared Padalecki appear in Episode 5 as morally dubious characters. On The Boys, superheroes don’t just save the day—they usually make things worse. Across four seasons, the Prime Video hit has pushed its satirical take on fame, power and corporate corruption to increasingly shocking extremes, turning caped icons into some of television’s most unpredictable villains. What started as a twisted take on superhero culture has only gotten bigger, darker, and crazier with each season. That trend continues with The Boys Season 5, the show’s highly anticipated final chapter. As the conflict between Billy Butcher (Karl Urban) and Homelander (Antony Starr) reaches its breaking point, the series is poised to deliver its biggest and most consequential showdown yet, with the future of Vought—and the world it controls—hanging in the balance.Keep reading for the full episode release schedule and everything else you need to know about how to watch The Boys Season 5. 🎬 SIGN UP for Parade’s Daily newsletter to get the latest pop culture news & celebrity interviews delivered right to your inbox 🎬 When is the premiere date for The Boys Season 5? The fifth and final season of The Boys debuts on Wednesday, April 8 with a two-episode premiere. How many episodes are in The Boys Season 8? The final season consists of eight episodes. Two episodes will premiere during the first week, followed by a new episode each Wednesday, with the series finale airing on May 20th. What day do new episodes of The Boys come out? New episodes of The Boys release on Wednesdays on Prime Video. Here’s the full season schedule: Wednesday, April 8, 2026: Episodes 1 and 2 Wednesday, April 15, 2026: Episode 3 Wednesday, April 22, 2026: Episode 4 Wednesday, April 29, 2026: Episode 5 Wednesday, May 6, 2026: Episode 6 Wednesday, May 13, 2026: Episode 7 Wednesday, May 20, 2026: Episode 8 How to watch The Boys The Boys is only available to stream on Prime Video. Related: Misha Collins Posts ‘Supernatural’ Shout Out To Jensen Ackles Ahead Of ‘The Boys’ Season 5 What scene did Jensen Ackles refuse to do in The Boys? Jensen Ackles made his debut as Soldier Boy—a twisted take on Captain America—in Season 3 of The Boys. But even on a show known for pushing boundaries, there was one moment the actor wasn’t willing to film. In an interview with Entertainment Weekly, Ackles admitted he drew a firm line when presented with a particularly explicit scene. “As a father of three, and a son and a husband and a self-respecting human being, I can’t do this,” he said recalling a conversation with showrunner Eric Kripke. “I didn’t know where my line was, but you found it.” Kripke, who previously worked with Ackles on Supernatural, confirmed they ultimately adjusted the moment. “We worked out a compromise where I got what I needed without him destroying his soul,” Kripke said in the same interview.While the EW piece didn’t specify the scene, Ackles later clarified in an interview with Fangasm that it involved a much more explicit intimate moment with an older woman—one briefly seen in Season 3, Episode 7, “Here Comes a Candle to Light You to Bed.” Who is in the cast of The Boys? The cast includes Karl Urban as Billy Butcher, Jack Quaid as Hughie Campbell, Antony Starr as Homelander, Erin Moriarty a Starlight, Jessie T. Usher as A-Train, Laz Alonso as Mother’s Milk, Chase Crawford as The Deep, Tomer Capone as Frenchie, Karen Fukuhara as Kimiko, Susan Heyward as Sister Sage, Valorie Curry as Firecracker and Jensen Ackles as Soldier Boy. Will Jared Padalecki be in The Boys? Yes! The Boys is bringing a little Supernatural reunion along for the ride in its final season. In a recent interview with Entertainment Weekly, showrunner Eric Kripke confirmed that both Misha Collins and Jared Padalecki appear in Episode 5. “What I love about what they’re doing is they’re just such douchebags. It’s great,” Kripke told EW. “I mean, Soldier Boy is no treat either, but they’re just really not morally upstanding dudes. It’s a blast to watch them play that. It was just so much fun.” Is there a trailer for the final season of The Boys? Of course! You can check out the most recent trailer for The Boys below. If you watch closely you’ll spot Collins and Padalecki. About the authorTerry Terrones began his journalism career in 2005, covering sports for a local daily before realizing he’d much rather write about aliens, time travel, and dramatic rose ceremonies. A lifelong pop culture fan, he quickly transitioned to covering TV, film, and entertainment news and hasn’t looked back.
